top_stories.title: Riots, vandalism, death & 780 arrests: PSG's Champions League win celebrations turn violent across France - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following **PSG**'s Champions League victory, celebrations in France turned violent, resulting in one death and 219 injuries.  Large crowds gathered around the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Elysees, setting off flares and celebrating with car horns, but clashes erupted between fans and police. Arrests reached over 780 nationwide, with Paris prosecutors placing 277 individuals in custody for various offenses. **Laurent Nunez**, French interior minister, stated that the situation was largely under control and most incidents occurred around the Champs-Elysees and near the Parc des Princes stadium.

top_stories.title: Firozabad horror: Trader slams toddler to death after mother rejects marriage proposal | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A 25-year-old trader, **Jitendra**, alias Viraj, was arrested by **Firozabad police** in a gunfight after allegedly killing an 18-month-old boy. The suspect lured the child out of his house on the pretext of buying him a treat and then attacked him on a deserted road before abandoning the body near his home.  Police recovered a country-made pistol and ammunition from **Jitendra**, who sustained a gunshot wound to his leg during an exchange with officers.

top_stories.title: Legislative Council election: Seat sharing finalised but Mahayuti and MVA camps yet to announce candidates | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mahayuti** and **Opposition MVA** alliances have finalized seat sharing agreements for the upcoming legislative council elections, but have yet to disclose most candidate names. The **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP** reached an agreement on 17 seats, with the **BJP** securing 11, **Shiv Sena** receiving 4, and the **NCP** getting 2. The disputes between the alliances revolve around seat allocation in specific districts, particularly over Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar —Jalna and Raigad-Ratnagiri-Sindhudurg.  The final candidate lists are expected to be announced on June 1st.

top_stories.title: IAEA concerned after Russia claims Ukraine attacked nuclear plant; says attacking Zaporizhzhia is like playing with fire | Today News
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Rafael Grossi**, Director General of the **International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)**, expressed serious concern after Russia accused Ukraine of attacking the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) in southern Ukraine.  The **IAEA** stated that a drone struck a turbine building at the site, causing damage and endangering nuclear safety. **Ukraine** denied the allegations, accusing **Russia** of "nuclear terrorism" and maintaining that its forces operate within international humanitarian law. The incident comes amid escalating tensions between Russia and Ukraine, with both sides launching attacks on energy targets.

top_stories.title: Mining explosives blast kills 55 in Myanmar's rebel-controlled area - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: A powerful explosion at a building in Kaungtup village, Shan State, killed at least 55 people and injured dozens more. The blast was caused by gelignite stored for mining operations by the **Ta'ang National Liberation Army (TNLA)**, an ethnic armed group that controls the area near the Chinese border. Rescue workers are still searching through debris for survivors and recovering bodies.  The incident occurred on Sunday in an area controlled by the TNLA, which has been fighting Myanmar's military government for years.

top_stories.title: Pak using rogue telecom signals to support terror groups in Jammu & Kashmir - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pakistan** is violating international telecommunication norms by beaming rogue cellular signals across the border into **Jammu and Kashmir**, providing a covert communication lifeline to terrorist groups. The signals, detected in various areas including jails, are reaching inmates through smuggled mobile devices despite attempts to block them with traditional jammers.  The **Indian government** has acknowledged the need for next-generation technology that can pinpoint and neutralize rogue devices within specific zones. This follows previous successful efforts by security agencies to dismantle similar networks in 2019-20, utilizing advanced encryption techniques developed by a Chinese firm. The signals are believed to be facilitated by YSMS services, merging smartphones with radio sets for encrypted communication.

top_stories.title: Delhi: Woman befriends new mother, flees with her 7-month-old from Delhi's GTB hospital - Delhi News | India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: A seven-month-old child was allegedly stolen from **GTB Hospital** in Delhi on Saturday after his mother, Nazreen, handed him to an unknown woman she had befriended.  Police are investigating the incident and have registered a kidnapping case. The missing infant and the unidentified woman are being sought by authorities.

top_stories.title: UP man beats 2-year-old daughter, repeatedly throws her into drain; arrested - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Monu alias Yogendra Singh**, a 50-year-old man from Uttar Pradesh, was arrested for allegedly assaulting his two-and-a-half-year-old daughter and attempting to drown her in a drain. The incident occurred on May 30th at around 2:30 pm and was captured on video that circulated on social media. **Police** launched an investigation after the video surfaced, leading to Singh's arrest. He is facing charges under relevant provisions of law and has been remanded to judicial custody pending further investigation.

top_stories.title: 29-year-old Indian scientist finds galaxy city, names it after Manipur's Loktak Lake - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: A 29-year-old Manipuri astrophysicist, Dr. Ronaldo Laishram, has discovered an ancient galaxy city named the Loktak Protocluster in the early universe. This discovery, published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, reveals that crowded cosmic environments accelerated early galaxy growth and challenges traditional timelines of galactic evolution. The protocluster is a massive collection of infant galaxies bound together by gravity, destined to form a single galaxy cluster over billions of years.  The study utilized data from the Subaru Telescope and NASA's James Webb Space Telescope to reveal this anomaly.

top_stories.title: Villagers Vandalise Trinamool MP's Party Office In Bengal's South 24 Parganas
top_stories.rephrased_article: **TMC** MP Bapi Haldar's party office in Mathurapur, South 24 Parganas district was vandalized by local villagers on Sunday. The incident followed allegations that flood relief materials were illegally stored at the office, prompting a mob to break windows and signage. **Haldar** denied any wrongdoing, claiming the materials were purchased for distribution among locals.  The **BJP** denied involvement in the vandalism.
